FINDING (high, correctness): plan-lock secondary messaging is not implemented. Evidence: `release_impact.analyze(... changed_paths=...)` exists, but `_plan_lock_main` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py:2020` through `:2127` never calls it or gathers git diff paths; `rg` found release-impact wiring only in `planning_readiness.py` / `dontpanic next`. Recommendation: add best-effort, non-blocking `dontpanic plan lock` output that uses git diff paths when available, without writing a v0 sidecar.

FINDING (medium, correctness): glob-style draft intent misses representative docs paths. Evidence: `analyze_plan_intent(allowed_paths=["docs/**"])` returned no surfaces and `internal_only=True`, despite the test matrix claiming `Allowed_paths=docs/** -> root_changelog + readme suggestions`; the code passes globs straight into `analyze_paths` at `release_impact.py:443-455`. Recommendation: normalize/expand broad `allowed_paths` globs through explicit intent rules, and add an assertion for `docs/**`.

$ git diff --stat HEAD~1
$ git diff --name-status HEAD~1
